title: Brash typed task graph
description: The only structure an LLM is permitted to emit. Actions, parameters, and dependencies are all closed vocabularies validated after generation.

goal_predicate.description: Measurable final condition, for example verified_at(drill_01, shelf_B12).

rationale.description: Free-text explanation retained for operator display only. Never parsed or executed.

id.description: Node identifier. Sequential n1, n2, ... keeps generated graphs diffable.

action.description: Must resolve to an entry in the Action Library. The validator rejects anything else.

parameters.description: Action parameters. Keys and value types are checked against the Action Library signature.

required_capabilities.description: Robot-independent capability names. Never a robot identifier.

proposed_robot_id.description: Optional LLM suggestion. The scheduler owns the final decision and may ignore it.
